newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Spokeswoman denies talk Russia's Chubais has quit.
newsitem.headline: Spokeswoman denies talk Russia's Chubais has quit.

text.p: The press office of Russian presidential chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais on Thursday denied rumours in financial markets that Chubais had quit. "The rumour is not true, we will be releasing a statement denying it," a spokeswoman said.
The rumours unsettled Russia's government securities market, already nervous at the fact that President Boris Yeltsin has been in hospital with pneumonia for over a week.
